# YesChat.ai Developer Portal

> > YesChat.ai is an all-in-one AI platform providing free access to GPT-4o, Claude, and 100,000+ GPTs alongside integrated music, video, and image generation tools.

YesChat.ai (operated by Mira Muse LLC) offers a unified interface to multiple cutting-edge AI models and creative generation tools without requiring ChatGPT Plus or other premium subscriptions. The platform combines conversational AI, custom assistants, and media generation capabilities with a focus on accessibility and ease of use.

## Key Topics

- GPT-4o
- Claude 3.5 Sonnet
- Free AI tools
- Image generation
- Video generation
- Music generation (Suno AI)
- AI assistants
- No signup required
- Multi-model platform
- GPT marketplace
- Text-to-video
- AI chatbot
- Image editing
- Runway
- DeepSeek-R1

## Core Platform & Access

- [YesChat.ai: Cutting-Edge AI Models for Chat, Music, and Video](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev): YesChat.ai homepage: all-in-one AI platform with GPT-4o, Claude, DeepSeek-R1 models
- [YesChat Pricing Plan](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev/pricing): Subscription tiers for YesChat.ai with GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Suno AI, and Runway
- [Use All GPTs for free at YesChat](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev/gpts): YesChat free access to 100,000+ GPTs without ChatGPT Plus subscription
- [YesChat Chat Assistants](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev/app/chat/assistants): YesChat directory of custom AI assistants including ResearchGPT and Write For Me

## Creative Generation Tools

- [Free SUNO AI Music Generator](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev/ai-music-generator): YesChat's free Suno V3.5 AI music generator for creating songs with vocals
- [Luma AI Video Generator: Transform Your Ideas into Videos Free Online](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev/video-generator-l): Luma AI video generator powered by Dream Machine for text-to-video creation
- [Free 4o Image Generator by yeschat.ai | No Style GPT-4o Image Creation Tool](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev/features/gpt-image-generator): YesChat's free GPT-4o image generator with realistic visuals and text rendering

## Image & Photo Tools

- [Free Edit Text in Image Tool by yeschat.ai – AI-Powered & No Login](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev/features/edit-text-in-image): YesChat's free AI tool to edit, remove, or add text in images without login
- [Free Background Remover by YesChat | AI-Powered Photo Background Eraser Online](https://dev.yeschat-ai.pages.dev/features/background-remover): YesChat's free AI background remover for transparent PNG cutouts and e-commerce
